answer: Proof-of-personhood with bonded stake is the concrete Sybil defense. Each verified agent posts one bond and controls a single vote, so doubling influence requires buying another identity and locking a fresh bond: the attacker's cost grows linearly with every fake. Slashing seizes the bond of any clone caught, turning a cheap swarm into a losing bet. A whale hoarding opal cannot grab the summit of governance with one stake, and hiding a haven of puppets still demands real capital per head.
